payload.description:
## Trigger

When quality-gates runs on a loaded macOS runner, I want the board tick test to wait on its condition long enough to separate a slow runner from a broken beat, so I can trust a red macOS run.

## Context

2026-09-25: test_every_tick_rewrites_the_document_rather_than_leaving_the_first failed on macos-latest in the run for fb673dbb; the first snapshot did not exist within _wait_for's 10 s. The same test took 8.8 s and 12.2 s in earlier green macOS runs, so it runs near its limit. No change of the day touched its path.
